name: Evanston Fall Mini B 2023
information:
This is a short competition with only three events. It is in series with [Evanston Fall Mini A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonFallMiniA2023) and [Evanston Fall Mini C](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonFallMiniC2023), which means that you can only compete in one of the three competitions.

Current Northwestern students may register for free. If you are a student, follow the directions on the [Registration and Waitlist](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonFallMiniB2023#35120-registration-and-waitlist) tab.

Please read all tabs before registering. On the day of the competition, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
